semiconductor_relevance: High — The company is focused on semiconductor packaging equipment, specifically IC die bonding, which is critical in the assembly process.
summary: Yilong Semiconductor equipments (Wuxi) Co., Ltd specializes in the development and manufacturing of semiconductor packaging equipment, with a strong emphasis on IC die bonding equipment. Since its inception in 2013, the company has focused on high-accuracy equipment through continuous technological innovation to meet the demands of the semiconductor packaging industry.
